description: A two-panel composite of X-ray diffraction patterns. Both panels plot intensity (vertical axis labelled "Intensity(au)", in arbitrary units with no numeric ticks) against diffraction angle "Diffraction angle 2θ (degree)", with tick labels at 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90 and 100°. Each panel stacks three vertically offset diffractograms labelled from top to bottom "6Cr", "3Cr" and "0Cr". Reflections are annotated in colour: red for γ-austenite — (111)γ, (200)γ, (220)γ, (311)γ, (222)γ; blue for δ-ferrite — (110)δ, (200)δ, (211)δ; and green (220)DO3 for the ordered DO3 phase. In (a) the blue δ and green DO3 labels are drawn separately near the low-angle doublet; in (b) that doublet carries a combined label "(110)δ/(220)DO3". The strongest peaks lie near 43–45°, near 50° and near 73°, with weaker features near 65°, 87° and 95°. Peak positions coincide for 0Cr, 3Cr and 6Cr within each panel, so the phase assemblage appears unchanged by Cr content. The caption supplied with this group states the patterns are of "CR20%" and "CR20% + annealed" steel strips, but the labels actually printed on the curves read 6Cr, 3Cr and 0Cr; this caption/pixel disagreement is unresolved. No numeric peak positions or intensities are printed anywhere.
measured_quantities: diffraction intensity (au, arbitrary units, no printed scale)

observations.observation: Both panels are XRD patterns with intensity in arbitrary units (axis labelled 'Intensity(au)', no numeric ticks) plotted against 'Diffraction angle 2θ (degree)' with tick labels at 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90 and 100.
Each panel contains three vertically offset diffractograms labelled from top to bottom '6Cr', '3Cr' and '0Cr'.
Reflections are colour-coded: red labels (111)γ, (200)γ, (220)γ, (311)γ, (222)γ for γ-austenite; blue labels (110)δ, (200)δ, (211)δ for δ-ferrite; green label (220)DO3 for the ordered DO3 phase.
In panel (b) the low-angle doublet is annotated with the combined label '(110)δ/(220)DO3', whereas in panel (a) the δ (blue) and DO3 (green) labels are drawn as separate annotations.

The most intense reflections in both panels occur between about 43° and 45°, near 50° and near 73°, with weaker peaks near 65°, 87° and 95°; no numeric intensity or 2θ values are printed on the plots.
Within each panel the three patterns (6Cr, 3Cr, 0Cr) show the same reflection positions, so no new phase appears to be introduced by Cr content in the plotted state.
The caption states that Fig. 7 shows X-ray diffraction patterns of the CR20% and CR20% + annealed steel strips.

The curve labels actually printed in the pixels read '6Cr', '3Cr' and '0Cr' in both panels, not 'CR20%'/'CR20% + annealed'; the caption and the pixels therefore disagree, and the image cannot confirm which condition each panel represents.
The citing text states that CR20% is the steel cold rolled with 20% reduction and CR20% + annealed is further annealed at 600 °C for 3 h after cold rolling.
The citing text states that after cold rolling the constituent phases are still γ-austenite and δ-ferrite with an ordered DO3 phase, completely consistent with the as-cast steel strips.

The citing text states that after further annealing a change from double-peak to single-peak between 43.5° and 45.0° occurs in the CR20% + annealed steel strips; the supplied pixels show a closely spaced peak pair in this region but do not allow the double-versus-single distinction to be verified numerically.
The paper title identifies the material system as near-rapidly solidified low-density Fe-20Mn-9Al-1.2C-xCr (wt.%) steels.

subfigures.description: XRD patterns (intensity au vs 2θ 30-100°) of three stacked strips labelled 6Cr (top), 3Cr and 0Cr (bottom). Reflections annotated (111)γ, (200)γ, (220)γ, (311)γ, (222)γ in red; (110)δ, (200)δ, (211)δ in blue; (220)DO3 in green. A closely spaced peak pair appears between ~43.5° and ~45°, and the strongest peaks are near 43-45°, ~50° and ~73°.

The same three stacked patterns (6Cr top, 3Cr middle, 0Cr bottom) over the same 2θ range. The low-angle doublet carries the combined label (110)δ/(220)DO3 plus (200)γ, while (200)δ and (211)δ labels appear in blue at higher angles; peak positions match those in (a).

unreadable_items: No numeric 2θ values are printed for the individual peaks, so peak positions can only be located against the 10°-spaced axis ticks
Whether panel (a) and panel (b) correspond respectively to CR20% and CR20% + annealed cannot be determined from the pixels; both panels carry identical 6Cr/3Cr/0Cr curve labels
Some small rotated δ-ferrite labels (blue) are of low legibility at the supplied resolution
